name: Masked Completion via GAN Inversion
definition: A conditional sampling technique that completes a 3D radiance field by inverting a 2D discriminator-trained generator, using photometric error on non-masked regions to guide the optimization.
summary: Masked Completion via GAN Inversion completes 3D radiance fields by optimizing a pre-trained GAN's latent code to match non-masked regions, distinguishing itself by avoiding neural network weight optimization.
